steps.observation: You have 10 seconds. Write a short story about a lighthouse keeper.

steps.action: Once upon a time, atop a rocky cliff overlooking a tumultuous sea, stood an old lighthouse, its beacon a guide for weary sailors. The lighthouse keeper, a solitary man named Elias, had tended the light for decades. Every night, he climbed the spiraled stairs, ensuring the lens was spotless and the oil reserves plenty. Though the ocean roared and the winds howled, Elias found peace in his duties, for each flash of the light was his promise to those at sea: that they were not alone, and safety was within reach. On stormy nights, when the world felt on the brink of chaos, Elias hummed a tune his father once sang, steady as the rhythm of the waves. His heart was light, knowing he carried on a legacy of guidance and hope.
